a.lede: Many of these tools hinge on using generative AI to try out a variety of different tactics on a video to find what works best.
a.title: YouTube adds new creator tools like video A/B testing, dynamic thumbnails, and live dubbing

b.lede: Creators will be able to use AI in a conversational chat interface to help them edit videos.
b.title: YouTube’s conversational video editing tool lets creators make edits in natural language
